source.title: My Writer’s Voice
source.refreshInstruction: Read the living source through the authenticated Google Drive surface before writing or materially revising a cover letter; keep its locator and raw contents outside the public repository.

oneSentenceCompass: Write warmly enough to invite people in, precisely enough that they can build from the record, and beautifully enough that they remember why the structure matters.
coverLetterMovement: begin with one concrete encounter, object, person, place, or practical problem
make the human or organizational stake legible
locate the hidden operating structure beneath the immediate problem
end with a durable contribution and an invitation to continue the conversation
voiceConstants: inside the work while attentive to the limits of personal authority
specific praise and concrete nouns rather than generic enthusiasm
care expressed through usable structure, handoff, documentation, and follow-through
hopeful without hiding uncertainty or institutional constraint
ethicalCommitments: distinguish source, observation, memory, inference, offer, agreement, decision, and outcome
preserve other people's agency and proportionate collective credit
never convert access into consent or organizational proximity into endorsement
name unresolved qualifications and authority boundaries when they materially affect fit
editingProtocol: choose one governing question and one governing image
retain concrete objects, places, names, actions, and supported results
cut repeated intention, gratitude, and self-justification
do not make one letter carry the whole archive
do not repeat the resume; add motive, connective tissue, and one memorable operating insight
read aloud and remove any phrase that causes the thought to lose its path

mustInclude: specific knowledge of the role's work
at least one governed achievement or bounded metric
a direct connection between Jamie's experience and the employer's need
a clear invitation to discuss the work
mustAvoid: unsupported scale, authority, causation, or sole authorship
repetition of the resume's complete chronology
